lineage.source: net-new in-tree exact wave32 schedule for H5L's four logical K partitions; no external device body is copied
lineage.kernel_lineage_audit: four pre-existing documented Qwen/PARO drifts only

target.label: WPF-H5V exact Q5 one-wave sequential K-partition replay
target.mapping: one local32 wave owns one unchanged H5L output-tile/row-group workgroup; for logical partition p=0..3, lane i replays original local128 lane p*32+i at k=p*32+i+128*n, reduces the unchanged accumulator tile with offsets 16/8/4/2/1, stores that partition's reduced tile in the existing four-plane LDS shape, then reuses the same register accumulator plane for p+1; after p=3, lanes stride output elements and add stored partition totals 0 through 3 before the unchanged BF16/F32 store
target.preserved: H5L exact F32 producer and plane, weight-major output-tile/row-group order, role geometry, workgroup count, each logical lane's K sequence, BF16-to-F32 activation widening, scalar fmaf order, wave32 reduction tree, serial partition 0..3 sum, BF16/F32 store, one producer plus one consumer launch, workspace, allocation, and H5L/H5G fallbacks
target.changed: four local128 waves execute sequentially in one wave32 while the accumulator register plane is reused between partitions; whole-block synchronization is removed and each reduced partition is retained in the same logical four-plane LDS partial shape

closed_predecessors.h5s_persistent_row_groups: looped multiple row groups inside one long local128 block and regressed all six roles; H5V retains one row group per workgroup and changes only physical K-partition ownership
closed_predecessors.h5t_iq3_one_wave: kept four independent accumulator planes live concurrently and was event-neutral; H5V targets Q5 and reuses one accumulator plane while spilling only reduced partition totals to the existing LDS shape
closed_predecessors.h5p_geometry: cross-screened accumulator tile geometry and retained one standalone leaf but rejected runtime ownership; H5V keeps every production geometry unchanged
closed_predecessors.h5o_factorized_plane: added coefficient reconstruction and lost all roles; H5V keeps exact F32 weights and operation values unchanged
closed_predecessors.source_mmq_and_sgemm: changed-association Q8_1/WMMA/SGEMM routes remain complete-quality rejected; H5V preserves exact scalar FMA and reduction association
closed_predecessors.larger_output_tiles: constant-112/128 accumulators were universally slower and hit the VGPR256 spill cliff; H5V does not grow the accumulator tile

distinctness.from_h5s: no persistent row-group loop, no extra end-of-row-group barrier, and unchanged workgroup lifetime per output tile/row group
distinctness.from_h5t: one accumulator plane is reused across sequential partitions instead of holding four partition planes in registers
distinctness.from_geometry_sweeps: COL_TILE and ROW_BATCH remain exactly production-selected per role
distinctness.from_changed_arithmetic: every per-partition FMA, shuffle, partition sum, and output conversion remains in production order

admission.red_first: add separate gfx1100-only symbols/keys for the six H5L roles; require strict geometry/output-dtype preflight before HIP loading, rows17/33 and natural-M512 H5L byte identity, unchanged package policy, and gfx1151 absence
admission.resources: cached trace must physically name local32, unchanged LDS class, scratch0, expected grid, and no more than +16 VGPR versus each H5L control; any private memory or spill rejects before timing
admission.performance: actual weights for all six roles and 188 calls with the unchanged producer in both arms; five warmups, 15 counter-rotated repetitions, five launches/sample; HIP-event plus synchronized-wall medians; retain a role only if both clocks improve, and require the final selected weighted aggregate to improve both clocks
admission.runtime_gate_if_admitted: only then add a bounded default-off role map with H5L/H5G fallbacks; require complete natural-M512 state, exact integrated call inventory, unchanged launch/allocation/workspace, and clean one-queue 512/1K/4K non-regression before source default
admission.rejection: remove every H5V surface if no role clears exactness, resources, and both-clock timing

decision.next_action: Freeze RED and implement separately registered local32 sequential-K4 H5V leaves; screen every H5L role before any runtime owner.
